Network Security

Geçici Port Rastgeleleştirme

A technique where ephemeral (temporary) TCP/UDP ports are assigned randomly to reduce the risk of port prediction attacks, as defined in IETF RFC 6056 and NIST SP 800-77.

A technique where ephemeral (temporary) TCP/UDP ports are assigned randomly to reduce the risk of port prediction attacks, as defined in IETF RFC 6056 and NIST SP 800-77.
